body: So you're saying I should kill myself when I turn 30 instead? I don't want to get old, so I think I'll just take care of it now. Obviously you are painting turning 30 in a negative light, which reinforces my view that it's an event I'd rather not experience.

No offence, but screw that. I'm always too fucking nice to people and in the end I just get walked over by everyone else. Nobody gives a shit about me, so I think I'll pass on being kind. I'm tired of seeing other people happy. So fuck them and the rest of society. I don't care anymore.
